versions.content: Application based authentication Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall provide means to applications to change the authentication state of unauthenticated connections. Rationale: An individual authentication with each ECU in the vehicle might be take too much time some for some applications. Use Case: An application based centralized authentication broadcast is required to gain access to a set of diagnostic services. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: Concept 636 "Security Extensions"
